scripts.dev:backend: cross-env DEBUG=true node scripts/run-uv.mjs run --directory backend uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000
scripts.db:migrate: cross-env DEBUG=true node scripts/run-uv.mjs run --directory backend alembic upgrade head
scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix frontend install && node scripts/run-uv.mjs sync --directory backend --python 3.12 && npm run db:up && npm run db:migrate && npm run seed
scripts.lint: npm run lint:backend && npm run lint:frontend
scripts.lint:backend: node scripts/run-uv.mjs run --project backend ruff check backend
scripts.format: npm run format:backend && npm run format:prettier
scripts.format:backend: node scripts/run-uv.mjs run --project backend ruff format backend
scripts.format:check: npm run format:check:backend && npm run format:check:prettier
scripts.format:check:backend: node scripts/run-uv.mjs run --project backend ruff format --check backend
scripts.seed: cross-env DEBUG=true node scripts/run-uv.mjs run --directory backend python -m app.db.seed
scripts.test:backend: cross-env DEBUG=true node scripts/run-uv.mjs run --project backend pytest backend/tests
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend

backend/**/*.py: node scripts/run-uv.mjs run --project backend ruff check --fix
node scripts/run-uv.mjs run --project backend ruff format
node scripts/run-uv.mjs run --project backend ruff check
node scripts/run-uv.mjs run --project backend ruff format --check
